listing.name: (KTZ) TrueWeaponStats v1.2
listing.aiSummary: Displays calculated weapon stats in the Refit screen, including built-in superweapons and slot-specific perks.

description: Modernizes the Unthemed Weapons Utilities mod for Starsector 0.98a. It queries live weapon instances to accurately account for phase hulls and slot-specific bonuses. Includes an [ALT] toggle to view vanilla stats and supports multiple languages via runtime bytecode inspection.
